responsibility: Build-time generator for the LoongArch ISA-evolution metadata files. It reads genopts/isa-evolution.in and emits either loongarch-evolution.h or loongarch-evolution.cc, constructing the cpucfg-to-feature map, useful cpucfg word index list, EVO_* feature enumeration, ISA_HAS_* condition macros, option-mask tables, builtin macro names, and per-feature ISA version arrays that the backend uses to model incremental ISA extensions.
